current.text: Strus joined the Clippers in a trade from Cleveland (the Watson deal).
He is projected to start for the Clippers next to Darius Garland, Derrick Jones Jr., Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson.
The expert is not confident in that starting five.
He is over 30 and in the last year of his contract.
A Jones fracture limited him to about 12 games last season, and he finished outside the top 250 in category leagues.
Brandon Ingram is out, along with Bradley Beal and Jordan Miller.
With Ingram out, his usage and minutes should go up. Watch whether his assists get back to about 4 a game.
He is worth a late-round flyer. If his minutes get back near 32, he could rank around the top 120.
The expert expects a trial season for the Clippers, with long rotations and many players tested. Coach Ty Lue often changes his rotations.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: He takes a lot of difficult threes.
He is known as an elite shooter, but his threes go in at an ordinary rate.
Injury history: a Jones fracture cost him most of the 2025-26 season.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both price him at 0 USD and rank him around 205 to 209, outside the 144 players our league drafts. He is at most a 1 USD last pick or an early waiver watch. His value is threes from a forward slot with few turnovers, and he gives little in steals, blocks and FG%. Early on, check whether his minutes get near 32 and his assists near 4 while Ingram is out. The Clippers' 4-3-4 playoff schedule and few back-to-backs make him easier to hold if the role is there.
